en: I can read a short story or a personal account and follow the plot.
I can understand the requirements and the application steps in a job advert.
I can write a text of 80–120 words setting out my view with reasons.
I can write a formal email (an application, a request for information, a complaint).
I can tell an event or an experience in time order and with conjunctions.
I can write a comment on a forum and reply to somebody else's view.
I can choose between the informal and the formal register (du/Sie, the greeting, the close).
I can build subclauses with conjunctions like obwohl, damit and während.
I can build polite requests and hypotheses with the Konjunktiv II (würde, hätte, könnte).
I can build the Passiv in the Präsens and the Präteritum.
I can build a Relativsatz (der/die/das … ist).
I can use the Präteritum with the verbs of narration (war, hatte, ging, kam).
I can get the Genitiv right in its basic uses (wegen, trotz, des Vaters).
I can defend my view in a debate and answer the opposing one.
I can discuss an abstract subject (the environment, technology, education) with its pros and cons.
I can describe my experience and my strengths in detail at a job interview.
I can describe a problem and set out its causes and possible solutions.
I can give a structured five-minute presentation and answer questions on it.
I can move naturally between the formal and the informal register.
I can follow the outline and the arguments of a long talk or lecture.
I can tell the speakers' positions apart in a radio discussion.
I can catch the implications and the shifts of tone in a dialogue at natural speed.
I can take detailed information from a documentary or a podcast episode.
I can listen to the minutes of a meeting and note the decisions and who is responsible.
I can understand the writer's stance and the implied meaning in a long column or interview.
I can understand the terms in a contract, a tenancy or business correspondence.
I can understand an article outside my field (science, economics) with its main idea and evidence.
I can analyse the structure of an essay (thesis, reasons, conclusion).
I can gather information from different sources and compare it.
I can write a text of 150–200 words weighing the pros and cons of a subject.
I can write a formal letter of complaint or application and justify it.
I can summarise a text and add my own view.
I can give a structured reply to a view in a letter to the editor or a forum post.
I can build flowing paragraphs with conjunctions and transitions (zwar…aber, einerseits…andererseits).
I can use the Passiv in every tense and tell 'werden/sein + Partizip' apart.
I can report speech with the Konjunktiv I.
I can build adjective phrases with the Partizip I/II.
I can move between Nominalisierung and Verbalisierung.
I can use the paired conjunctions correctly (nicht nur…sondern auch, je…desto).
I can use the Plusquamperfekt and the Futur II to relate events in time.
I can present and discuss a complex subject fluently and in a structured way.
I can use fine differences of meaning and register (irony, degrees of politeness).
I can look for a compromise in a negotiation with concessions and conditions.
I can bring idioms and set phrases into my speech naturally.
I can correct myself and rephrase in the middle of a long turn.
I can understand long speech that is fast, dialectal or in a noisy setting.
I can catch the unspoken stance, the irony and the hints in a panel or a debate.
I can follow the structure of the argument in an academic lecture.
I can understand colloquial speech and cultural references in films and series.
I can understand long and complex texts (essays, articles, literature) with their implied meanings.
I can extract the information I need from specialist texts (legal, medical, technical).
I can analyse a writer's style and rhetorical devices.
I can compare different views and assess them critically.
I can write a long, clearly structured essay or report (300+ words).
I can adapt my style to the reader and the purpose (formal, academic, journalistic).
I can summarise a complex subject and add a critical comment.
I can hold a long text together with conjunctions and references.
I can build complex syntax (nested subclauses, Partizipialkonstruktionen).
I can use the Modal Partikeln (doch, ja, mal, eben) and the markers of register naturally.
I can build the past and the finer uses of the Konjunktiv II (hätte…sollen).
I can use the set verb-noun combinations (Funktionsverbgefüge).
